raised_by: the W04-02 round-2 independent reviewer, which counted three drifted pins and measured them

drift_detail.why: routing became table-driven so W04-02's check id is served by the Go program while every other selector still forwards to ops/ci/context.py
W04-02 added its own phases, the faultOf helper and new negative assertions to the shared check program
registry revision 11 added check_id W04-02 to test.context; this one was already disclosed in the revision note

step_state_evidence_pins.note: these pin files inside the W04-01 receipt directory and none of them changed

cause: W04-02 legitimately modified three files that W04-01's receipt lists by artifact hash, and only the registry consequence was disclosed when it happened

per_file_reason.tests/context/check/main.go: W04-02 added its own phases, the faultOf helper and new negative assertions to the shared check program
per_file_reason.tests/context/check/legacy.go: routing became table-driven so W04-02's check id is served by the Go program while every other selector still forwards to ops/ci/context.py
per_file_reason.execution/v2.4/commands.json: registry revision 11 added check_id W04-02 to test.context; this one was already disclosed in the revision note

what_this_does_not_change: W04-01's acceptance is not withdrawn. Its 158 accepted assertion ids remain a strict subset of the current 239, which the round-2 reviewer verified independently, its forwarded selectors still reach ops/ci/context.py, and no gate it pinned was lowered. What changed is that the receipt's artifact hashes no longer describe the files as they now read - stated here rather than quietly re-pinned.
process_lesson: an acceptance should pin reviewed artifacts by commit rather than by live filesystem path, or the card that next touches a shared file should re-pin inside its own disclosed scope. Owner: the standing registry/receipt hygiene obligation.
drafting_disclosure: the first draft of this file recomputed the step_state pin set (20 entries, all intact) while describing the reviewer's claim about receipt.json's 30 artifact hashes. That was caught before commit by running the measurement, and both sets are reported separately now.
